name: Arbutin 7% + Tranexamic Acid 4% Cream | Brightening Moisturizer for Dark Spots, Uneven Tone & Hydration | 50g
description:
Give your skincare routine a brightening and moisturizing boost with Arbutin 7% + Tranexamic Acid 4% Cream. Formulated with Alpha-Arbutin, Tranexamic Acid, Niacinamide, Sodium Hyaluronate, Allantoin, and Licorice Root Extract, this lightweight facial cream is designed to support a more even-looking complexion while helping maintain skin hydration. The moisturizing formula combines brightening-focused ingredients with skin-conditioning and hydrating components. Its smooth, non-greasy texture makes it convenient for everyday skincare and suitable for incorporating into morning or evening routines.

Key Features
7% Arbutin Formula – Contains Alpha-Arbutin as a key brightening-focused ingredient.
4% Tranexamic Acid – Formulated with Tranexamic Acid to support a more even-looking skin tone.
Niacinamide Enriched – Contains Niacinamide as part of the skin-conditioning formula.
Hydrating Moisturizer – Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, and Sodium Hyaluronate help support skin moisture.
Skin-Soothing Ingredients – Includes Allantoin to provide skin-conditioning care.
Licorice Root Extract – Contains Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract as part of the botanical ingredient blend.
Brightening Skincare – Designed for skincare routines focused on the appearance of dullness, uneven tone, and dark spots.
Lightweight Texture – Designed to blend easily into the skin without a heavy or greasy feel.
Morning or Evening Use – Convenient for incorporating into a regular facial skincare routine.

Product Specifications
Product Type: Brightening Moisturizing Face Cream
Key Actives: Alpha-Arbutin 7%, Tranexamic Acid 4%
Other Key Ingredients: Niacinamide, Sodium Hyaluronate, Allantoin, Licorice Root Extract
Skin Concerns: Dull-looking skin, uneven-looking skin tone, appearance of dark spots
Texture: Lightweight cream
Net Weight: 50g

How to Use
Apply an appropriate amount to clean, dry facial skin.
Gently spread and massage until absorbed.
Use as part of your morning or evening skincare routine.
During daytime use, apply a suitable broad-spectrum sunscreen as the final step of your skincare routine.

Ingredients
Water
Glycerin
Methylpropanediol
Cetearyl Alcohol
Niacinamide
Dimethicone
Ammonium Acryloyldimethyltaurate/VP Copolymer
1,2-Hexanediol
Hydroxyacetophenone
Cetearyl Stearate
PEG-100 Stearate
Cetearyl Glucoside
Sodium Stearate
Polyurethane-35
Allantoin
Alpha-Arbutin
Tranexamic Acid
Butylene Glycol
Dianthus Chinensis Extract
Paeonia Suffruticosa Root Extract
Alumina
Triethoxycaprylylsilane
Sodium Hyaluronate
Titanium Dioxide
Phenoxyethanol
Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract
Ethylhexylglycerin

Safety Information
For external use only.
Avoid direct contact with the eyes.
Perform a patch test before applying to the full face, especially if you have sensitive skin.
Discontinue use if irritation, redness, or discomfort occurs.
Keep out of reach of children.
Store in a cool, dry place away from excessive heat and direct sunlight.

Package Includes
